info.name: ERPjs API Collection
info.description:
Complete API collection for ERPjs — REST endpoints and GraphQL operations.

Base URL: {{baseUrl}} (default: http://localhost:8888)

**Authentication:** Most protected routes require a Bearer token. Login first, then set the `authToken` collection variable.

**GraphQL:** All CRUD and business logic is handled via POST /graphql. REST routes handle auth, file uploads, webhooks, and binary downloads.
